quests.instruction: Which small letter is the same letter as U?
quests.hint: Say the name of U: 'you'. The small letter has the same name.
quests.explanation: Capital U, small u. Compare UFO and ufo.
quests.funFact: In blue and glue, the letters 'ue' say 'oo'.

quests.instruction: Small n has a big partner. Which one is it?
quests.hint: Think of Nut. What capital letter does it begin with?
quests.explanation: N is the partner of n. It looks like two tall lines joined by a slanted line.
quests.funFact: Capital N is made of three lines: up, down and up again.

quests.instruction: Which pair has L next to its small letter?
quests.hint: One pair has two letters named 'ell'. Which one?
quests.explanation: Ll is right. The other pairs do not have the same letter in both places.
quests.funFact: Capital L looks like a stick with a foot.

quests.instruction: BANK is written in capital letters. Which one is the same word in small letters?
quests.hint: Check the first letter and the last letter first: B goes with b, and K goes with k.
quests.explanation: BANK and bank are the same word, written in two ways. The other words, back and bunk, have a different letter somewhere.
quests.funFact: B is letter number 2 of the 26 letters, with 1 letters before it and 24 after it.

quests.instruction: Match the small t with its capital letter.
quests.hint: Say the name of t: 'tee'. The capital letter has the same name.
quests.explanation: T is the partner of t. It looks like a tall line with a bar across the top.
quests.funFact: Capital T is a tall line with a bar on top, like a hat.

quests.instruction: One pair joins J to the wrong small letter. Which pair is it?
quests.hint: Look at the pairs one at a time. Which pair mixes up two different letters?
quests.explanation: iJ is the odd one: J goes with j, not with i.
quests.funFact: Almost no English words end with the letter j.

quests.instruction: Which lowercase letter matches A?
quests.hint: Say the name of A: 'ay'. The small letter has the same name.
quests.explanation: Capital A, small a. Compare Alligator and alligator.
quests.funFact: A and I are the only single letters that are also everyday English words.

quests.instruction: Find kids written in capital letters.
quests.hint: Match the letters one at a time, from left to right.
quests.explanation: KIDS and kids are the same word, written in two ways. The other words, BIDS and KITS, have a different letter somewhere.
quests.funFact: Lowercase k is tall, like b, d, h and l.

quests.instruction: Which capital letter is the same letter as v?
quests.hint: The capital partner looks like two slanted lines that meet at the bottom.
quests.explanation: V and v are two forms of the same letter, named 'vee'.
quests.funFact: Capital V is two lines that meet at the bottom.

quests.instruction: Which pair matches X with the same letter?
quests.hint: Say the name of each letter in the pair. Do both names match?
quests.explanation: Xx is a match: X and x are the same letter, 'ex'. The other pairs mix two different letters.
quests.funFact: At the end of a note, X often means a kiss.

quests.instruction: The word Mango begins with a capital M. Which small letter is the partner of M?
quests.hint: Say Mango and listen to the first sound. Which small letter makes the same sound?
quests.explanation: In mango, the same letter is written small: m.
quests.funFact: Lowercase m has two humps, and n has one.

quests.instruction: A sign says STAR. Which word says the same thing in small letters?
quests.hint: Each capital letter has a small partner. Find the word whose letters are all partners.
quests.explanation: STAR and star are the same word, written in two ways. The other words, stay and stir, have a different letter somewhere.
quests.funFact: S and Z are made the same way in your mouth, but for Z your voice buzzes.

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that goes with z.
quests.hint: Think of Zero. What capital letter does it begin with?
quests.explanation: Z and z are two forms of the same letter, named 'zee'. A word to remember it by: Zero.
quests.funFact: In comics, 'zzz' is how we write the sound of sleeping.

quests.instruction: Find the pair that mixes up J with a different letter.
quests.hint: Look at the pairs one at a time. Which pair mixes up two different letters?
quests.explanation: Jl does not match: J and l are different letters. The other pairs show the same letter in two forms.
quests.funFact: J is letter number 10 of the 26 letters, with 9 letters before it and 16 after it.

quests.instruction: Match the capital O with its small letter.
quests.hint: Small o is the first letter of octopus. Capital O is the first letter of Octopus.
quests.explanation: o is the partner of O. It looks like a small round circle.
quests.funFact: The word 'oh' is spelled just like the letter's name, o-h.

quests.instruction: The word is star. Which sign says the same word in capital letters?
quests.hint: Check the first letter and the last letter first: S goes with s, and R goes with r.
quests.explanation: STAR and star are the same word, written in two ways. The other words, STIR and STAY, have a different letter somewhere.
quests.funFact: S can also say 'zzz', as in dogs and toys.

quests.instruction: Capital G has a small partner. Which one is it?
quests.hint: Say the name of G: 'gee'. The small letter has the same name.
quests.explanation: Capital G, small g. Compare Guitar and guitar.
quests.funFact: In ring and song, n and g work together to make one sound.

quests.instruction: Which pair joins A to the same letter in small form?
quests.hint: Check each pair: are both letters the same letter, one big and one small?
quests.explanation: Both A and a are called 'ay', so Aa is the partner pair.
quests.funFact: A is letter number 1 of the 26 letters, with 0 letters before it and 25 after it.

quests.instruction: Which uppercase letter matches b?
quests.hint: Say the name of b: 'bee'. The capital letter has the same name.
quests.explanation: B and b are two forms of the same letter, named 'bee'.
quests.funFact: Lowercase b looks like a bat beside a ball: the stick comes first, then the circle.

quests.instruction: Look at the sign: SALE. Which word matches it in lowercase letters?
quests.hint: Match the letters one at a time, from left to right.
quests.explanation: SALE and sale are the same word, written in two ways. The other words, same and safe, have a different letter somewhere.
quests.funFact: Sock, soap and spoon all begin with S.

quests.instruction: Which pair does NOT match? One of them mixes up U.
quests.hint: Say each letter's name. One pair has two different names.
quests.explanation: Uy is the odd one: U goes with u, not with y.
quests.funFact: Long ago, U and V were written as the same letter.

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that goes with I.
quests.hint: Say the name of I: 'eye'. The small letter has the same name.
quests.explanation: i is the partner of I. It looks like a short line with a dot on top.
quests.funFact: The letter i hides in the middle of tiny, big and little.

quests.instruction: Which capital letter is the same letter as r?
quests.hint: Think of Rhino. What capital letter does it begin with?
quests.explanation: Capital R, small r. Compare Rhino and rhino.
quests.funFact: Rabbit, rainbow and rocket all begin with R.

quests.instruction: Which capital-letter sign matches the word toys?
quests.hint: Each capital letter has a small partner. Find the word whose letters are all partners.
quests.explanation: TOYS and toys are the same word, written in two ways. The other words, TOES and BOYS, have a different letter somewhere.
quests.funFact: T says 'tuh', a quick tap of your tongue behind your top teeth.

quests.instruction: Two pairs are real partners. Which pair is wrong? Look at the pair with C.
quests.hint: Look at the pairs one at a time. Which pair mixes up two different letters?
quests.explanation: eC is the odd one: C goes with c, not with e.
quests.funFact: Capital C looks like a mouth open to the right.

quests.instruction: MILK is written in capital letters. Which one is the same word in small letters?
quests.hint: Check the first letter and the last letter first: M goes with m, and K goes with k.
quests.explanation: MILK and milk are the same word, written in two ways. The other words, mild and silk, have a different letter somewhere.
quests.funFact: Moon, monkey and mango all begin with M.

quests.instruction: Which lowercase letter matches W?
quests.hint: Small w is the first letter of wolf. Capital W is the first letter of Wolf.
quests.explanation: W and w are two forms of the same letter, named 'double-u'.
quests.funFact: W is letter number 23 of the 26 letters, with 22 letters before it and 3 after it.

quests.instruction: The word is menu. Which sign says the same word in capital letters?
quests.hint: Match the letters one at a time, from left to right.
quests.explanation: MENU and menu are the same word, written in two ways. The other words, MANY and MEND, have a different letter somewhere.
quests.funFact: A to M is the first half of the alphabet, and M is the last letter in that half.

quests.instruction: Which pair shows Z and its own small partner?
quests.hint: Check each pair: are both letters the same letter, one big and one small?
quests.explanation: zZ is a match: Z and z are the same letter, 'zee'. The other pairs mix two different letters.
quests.funFact: Z is the last letter of the alphabet.

quests.instruction: Small m has a big partner. Which one is it?
quests.hint: Say the name of m: 'em'. The capital letter has the same name.
quests.explanation: Capital M, small m. Compare Moon and moon.
quests.funFact: Your lips stay closed to say 'mmm', and the sound comes out through your nose.
